notes.title: Death Bowl – Live Stream!
notes.content:
Hey there,

We're Hard Six Studios – a group of old friends who have loved making games together for years. Death Bowl is our first commercial product and we're excited to share it with you.

Join us for a stream of our demo then pick up the full release on October 28th!

See you there,
Matt – H6S

notes.title: Death Bowl has an updated demo and is in Steam NextFest!
notes.content:
We're pleased to announce that Death Bowl is going to be featured in Steam NextFest! To give you a better sense of the most recent build, we've updated the demo. Changes include:

- Refined gameplay!
- Updated camera!
- Better gibs!
- More gallows humor!
- And more!
